author: 氷室 冴

en.title: The Leaden Sea and Memories of a Rainy Day
en.premise: Assistant Inspector Sakuma of the First Investigation Division is nearing retirement when he is ordered to reopen a cold case: a disappearance from twenty years ago. His investigation leads him to a peculiar secondhand bookstore on the outskirts of town that opens only on rainy days, where the owner holds fragmented memories of the incident. Caught in the friction of a bureaucracy obsessed with efficiency, Sakuma persists through painstaking interviews and meticulous record checks, chasing the 'voiceless message' left behind by the missing girl.

zh.title: 钝色的大海与雨日的记忆
zh.premise: 即将退休的搜查一课警部补·佐久间，被命令重新调查一起20年前的未解决失踪案。在调查过程中，他发现位于城镇边缘、仅在“雨天开业的旧书店”的店主，持有关于当年事件的碎片化记忆。在组织效率至上的压力与矛盾之中，佐久间通过地毯式的走访与记录比对，执着地追寻失踪少女留下的那条“无声的信息”。
